title: Pairwise Euclidean Distances
signature: def pairwise_distances(A: np.ndarray, B: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
hints: The a.b term for every pair is one matrix product, A @ B.T. The norms are a column vector plus a row vector, which broadcast to (n, m).
Rounding can make a squared distance slightly negative, like -1e-13, when two points are equal. Clip at 0 before the square root, or you get nan.
